goal: Complete pre-cycle4 feature lock audit for frontend-owned areas and produce reproducible evidence for web mode routing, write/save/re-query loop, chronos persistence, and universe render path.

inputs.description: Canonical pre-cycle4 gate and audit matrix.
Universe payload serialization and render path.

constraints.notes: Do not change backend gateway contracts or Android native code. If a blocker is found, mark explicit blocked evidence and stop scope expansion.

acceptance: Audit rows owned by frontend_ide have explicit verdicts (pass/partial/blocked) with evidence paths.
Mandatory test subset is executed and summarized: tests/test_interface_parity.py and tests/test_universe_3d_serialization.py.
Any change that affects user-facing behavior includes before/after evidence and regression impact note.

risk.note: Mode-level smoke checks can hide persistence and serialization regressions unless tests and code-path evidence are both included.

next_actions: Audit frontend-owned matrix rows with evidence and explicit verdict.
Run required test subset and capture command output summary.
Publish frontend pre-cycle4 result artifact for CT aggregation.
